svg.title: Divergent (rift) · stage 0.5
svg.desc: Plates move apart. The land sinks into a rift between stepped fault scarps; the shoulders rise slightly. Front face: rock layers drop in steps; the crust thins beneath the rift.
svg.text: Plates move apart. The land sinks into a rift between stepped fault scarps; the shoulders rise slightly.
Front face: rock layers drop in steps; the crust thins beneath the rift.
Storyboard (7A), authored from the 7A table; not simulated; not production art. Heights, layers ×4; crust base ×0.75.
